ambient_events: The genset changes pitch, hunts for a moment, and settles.
A gauge needle drifts up, hangs, and falls back. Nobody has looked at it in years.
Something arcs behind a panel — a hard blue snap and the smell of hot metal.
The floor hums through your boots at a frequency you feel in your teeth.
Cable runs vanish into the wall in a bundle thick as a man's arm, taped and re-taped.
The whole shack shudders once, like a cough, and carries on.
description: Two scavenged turbines the size of tanker drums roar behind cage rails, spun off the wind and whatever else the Reach can feed them. The air is hot, loud, and smells of ozone and burnt insulation. Everything is patched, and everything is one bad night from patching again.
name: The Turbine Floor
